description: The `self-learn` system is an AI-assisted developer tool and knowledge management system designed with a local-first, zero-runtime overhead architecture. The system operates on a CLI-first substrate where Git acts as the database, ensuring all ledger modifications are committed and pushed atomically. The UI Frontend (Client-Side app.js) communicates with the UI Server Core via HTMX and Server-Sent Events (SSE). To maintain the CLI as the single source of truth and avoid active runtime overhead during normal LLM execution, any state-modifying action in the UI is delegated to the UI CLI Verb Runner, which spawns the corresponding CLI Entrypoint command. The CLI Ledger Engine manages the file-based ledger and Git operations, while the CLI Pre-Analysis, Miner & Compilers run background tasks to analyze proposals, mine transcripts, and compile dotfiles. The UI LLM Engine manages active LLM pane sessions, providing an interactive environment for reviewing proposals and executing tools.

components.name: UI Frontend (Client-Side app.js)
components.description: Represents the client-side JavaScript application running in the user's browser. It handles keyboard navigation, HTMX event hooks, Server-Sent Events (SSE) message processing, pane rendering, and table sorting. It provides the interactive user interface for reviewing proposals, navigating records, and managing active LLM pane sessions.

components.name: UI Server Core & Presentation Layer
components.description: The FastAPI/Starlette web server that serves the Review UI. It manages the server lifecycle, configuration, security middleware (CSP, token authentication), view models (building front page, bucket page, and detail page models), SSE event hub, and idle monitoring. It acts as the orchestrator for the UI, rendering templates and coordinating with the CLI runner and session engines.

components.name: UI LLM Engine & Session Manager
components.description: Manages active LLM pane sessions, transcripts, and charter integration. It compiles the doctrine, defines engine events (BlockStart, TextDelta, ToolUse), implements the SdkPaneEngine, and handles transcript persistence and rendering (markdown, diff, yaml). It provides the interactive LLM context and tool execution environment.

components.name: UI CLI Verb Runner
components.description: Responsible for executing CLI commands (verbs) from the UI server. Since the system is CLI-first, any state-modifying action in the UI (like arming, confirming, or routing a proposal) is executed by spawning the corresponding CLI command. It ensures that the CLI remains the single source of truth and that the UI has zero active runtime overhead during normal LLM execution.

components.name: CLI Entrypoint & Ingestion
components.description: The entrypoint for the CLI. It parses command-line arguments, defines CLI commands (verbs), and formats CLI outputs. It also handles importing knowledge from external sources (backlog journals, memory files), the interactive teach command, and record parsing/validation. It ensures that all imported or newly created records conform to the ledger schema before they are written.

components.name: CLI Ledger Engine & GitOps
components.description: The core of the file-based ledger. It manages record definitions, ledger read/write operations, Git operations (commit, stage, push), and the Sentinel Manager (heartbeat, hold, release). It treats Git as the database, ensuring all ledger modifications are committed and pushed atomically.

components.name: CLI Pre-Analysis, Miner & Compilers
components.description: Contains the background worker, pre-analysis analyst, transcript miner, hook compilers, and Chezmoi integration. It runs background tasks to mine transcripts for near-misses, analyzes proposals using LLMs, generates hook scripts, and compiles user-scope dotfiles.
